contributions.text:
MONUMENT TO ENDURANCE: ADD, for Esper Sentinel (contested).
- It fires on a wheel's discard: the model (the per_discard_modes block) gives a draw on the first discard of a turn, a Treasure on the second, the life loss on the third; a seven-card wheel turn gets all three.
- The goldfish undercounts it: the life loss is scored against one seat, so 9 life a wheel turn reads as 3; its rows run mildly negative in every slot, as Q036 found on 2026-11-04. Siding with the pilot ("a clear add"): the deck discards nearly every turn — Kitsa's loot, Teferi's loot (on other players' turns too), Blood tokens, the Queen of Dale, Inti, Big Score, the wheels — and each Treasure pings off Jaws when sacrificed. That judgment decides it, not the goldfish.
- Cut 1, Esper Sentinel (contested): the Queen of Dale, added today, uses the same trigger (an opponent's first noncreature spell) and pays more — a loot plus a body; Sentinel's draw is taxed away by a payment of {1}. Cost: a turn-1 play and a 1/1 Human that can be given flying; log 009 shows it as a chump body. Goldfish: extra cards by T8 -1.4 [-1.6,-1.3], damage @T10 -8.8 [-10.3,-7.2], killed by T6 -1.9 pts [-2.3,-1.6] — pricing Sentinel's draws, blind to 6 extra life from Monument's drain.
- Cut 2, Mountain (contested): 37 lands to 36, still >= 35. Goldfish: missed drop by T5 +2.6 pts [+2.2,+3.0], mulliganed +1.4 pts [+1.1,+1.6]. Rocks before lands is the standing rule, but rock cuts were declined today. Colour sources not checked.
- Not cut: Winds of Change (the wheel that discards nothing) — finisher wheel by T8 -6.4 pts [-6.9,-5.9].

call.reading: Monument to Endurance in for Esper Sentinel: a draw, a Treasure and a drain on the turns the deck discards; the Queen of Dale took over Sentinel's trigger; the goldfish undercounts the drain.
